court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Managing Director, Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board and Another
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. Jerry V.V. Sundar
judgment_text:
Petition filed under Article 226 of The Constitution of India praying for the issuance of a writ of certiorari to call for the records relating to the demand notice dated 24.11.2021 issued by the second respondent and quash the same.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Senthilkumar Ramamoorthy, J.:— Demand notice dated 24.11.2021 is challenged in this writ petition. Learned counsel for the Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board has handed over a document indicating that dues upto the second half of 2025-2026 has been paid by the petitioner. Recording the same, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed. There shall be no order as to costs.
